label: NOT PRODUCTION. Illustrative assumptions taken verbatim from the transaction-cost PRD worked example (brokerage 0.10%/side, STT 0.10%/side, exchange 0.00325%, SEBI Rs 10/crore, GST 18% on brokerage+exchange only, stamp 0.015% buy). For tests only — do not use for real cost estimation. These numbers deliberately do NOT match any real broker's current schedule (e.g. real Zerodha delivery brokerage is Rs 0, not 0.10%/side) and the GST base excludes SEBI charges, unlike zerodha-equity-v1.
rounding: each component rounded to the paisa, ROUND_HALF_UP; GST computed on unrounded components
